$comment: The server clock the kits read wherever they compare now with an instant the server issued: plugin time blocks and their countdowns, the plugin rows, account and red packet times, invite cooldowns and relative feed times. Server now = device now + offsetMs, the host's estimate of the server clock minus the device clock (the core SDK's connection.getServerClock); without one (null) it is the device clock. countdown re-runs the plugin countdown rule (plugin-view-vectors rules.countdown) and regenerate the invite cooldown rule (invite-vectors regenerate) at server now; deviceClockZh / deviceClockEnabled are what the device clock alone gives, so each case shows what the offset changes.

countdown.note: No estimate yet: the device clock.
Closes 30 minutes after the server's now; a device 5 minutes fast still shows 30:00.
The same card on a device 5 minutes slow.
Two minutes left on the server; the device clock alone has already passed it.
Closed a minute ago on the server; the device clock alone still counts down.

regenerate.note: Ten minutes of cooldown left on the server; a device 15 minutes fast would offer regenerating now.
The cooldown ended a minute ago; a device 10 minutes slow would still say 9 minutes.
